 FOR NUTRITION in the format Textbook via Copyright Clearance Center.
To obtain muscle circumference:
1. Lay ruler between value of arm circumference and fatfold
2. Read off muscle circumference on middle line
To obtain tissue areas:
1.  The arm area and muscle area are alongside their respective 
circumferences
2. Fat area = arm area-muscle area
